§6Powercell (Low)§f

§aModular RF storage. Adjacent cells link into a shared multiblock network that scales with size.§f

The §bPowercell (Low)§f holds §e500,000 RF§f and transfers §e250 RF/t§f per side. Link up to §e729 blocks§f (9×9×9), every block adds §a+0.25×§f to the side transfer rate.

§9Right-click§f a face with a wrench to cycle between §bInput§f (blue), §cOutput§f (orange), and §7Disabled§f. Insert a §bPowercell Card§f for wireless linking across distances or dimensions.

Broke it? §aNo power lost§f, the block retains all stored energy.

§6Crafting§f: §b4× Power Core§f (cardinals) + §b4× Redstone§f (corners) + §b1 Machine Frame§f (center)

§9Note:§f A basic 2×2×2 Low network already transfers §e500 RF/t§f per side, enough to drive mid-game machinery.
